# David D'Angelo and Ashley Stirrup
Date: 2026-09-04 | Duration: 39.86000061035156m

## Summary
The team focused on improving podcast performance visibility, growth, and operational coordination. Ashley Stirrup requested current listens, subscribers, and minutes-consumed data from Apple, Spotify, and YouTube for board reporting, noting approximately $1 million in podcast pipeline versus $11 million influenced by paid ads. The team discussed platform-level and episode-level reporting, with YouTube producing the highest volume of listens and views. Growth tactics include ads, platform placements, SEO, guest social posts, supporting content, and cross-promotion through blogs, webinars, newsletters, and sales activity. Ashley emphasized reaching data scientists, product managers, and engineers while addressing low-quality YouTube traffic and ad software compliance issues. Guest promotion will be improved through reminders, post tracking, episode and guest-page links, review requests, and authentic engagement. The CMS will receive more consistent guest metadata, while a nearly complete automation system and weekly Friday performance reviews will improve communication and decision-making.

## Keywords
podcast metrics, audience growth, guest engagement, marketing strategy, analytics access, promotion

## Action Items

**Ashley Stirrup**
Obtain login credentials for Apple and Spotify podcast accounts to gain direct access to analytics data (05:27)
Review the weekly podcast performance dashboard and participate in Friday check-in meetings to align on analytics and growth strategy (32:08)
Continue managing guest engagement on LinkedIn by monitoring tagged posts and commenting authentically to nurture community and promote the podcast (15:34)

**David D'Angelo**
Provide Ashley with access to podcast platform analytics or consolidate data into a dashboard if direct access is not feasible (04:50)
Share guest communication scripts used for promotion and rating requests with Ashley to improve coordination and guest participation (14:54)
Facilitate weekly analytics review meetings starting soon to align marketing efforts and build confidence in the podcast growth strategy (31:44)

**Tanner Green**
Verify if Apple and Spotify podcast account access can be shared with Ashley; if not, prepare to send regular analytics updates to her (18:54)
Improve coordination with Emmy to ensure guest promotional links are shared timely and responses tracked; include Ashley and Karen in relevant communications (24:57)
Execute a guest posting tracking system to identify which guests post about the podcast and send reminders with templates to those who do not (22:02)
Investigate alternative compliant advertising software to replace the current suboptimal system and improve advertising efficiency (28:39)
Send detailed episode-level analytics reports on downloads and listens per platform (Apple, Spotify, YouTube) to Ashley for better performance insights (26:48)

**Emmy Sharp**
Update the podcast CMS to include guest roles and industry classifications for all episodes to enhance analytics and searchability (35:13)
Support Tanner in managing guest link sharing and promotional communication to improve guest participation and tracking (24:57)

**Karen Henke**
Coordinate with Emmy and Tanner to ensure data completeness, metadata tagging, and guest page updates are followed for improved podcast promotion and analytics (34:53)
